# zensation-ai/zenbrain

Agent memory for LLM agents: 7 neuroscience-inspired layers (working, episodic, semantic, procedural) with FSRS spaced repetition and memory consolidation. Zero-dependency TypeScript library, MCP server, Vercel AI SDK middleware. Wins 9/9 answer-quality comparisons on LongMemEval-500 (3 judges, Bonferroni).
